trans.sense: name of the letter Y, y
name of the letter Y, y

examples.text: Thus first C checks to see if ex and wye are equal. The resulting value of 1 or 0 (true or false) then is compared to the value of zee.
examples.ref: 1984 Waite, Prata & Martin, C (Computer Program Language), p. 190

examples.text: It said, in a whispering, buzzing voice, "Gee-you-ess-ess-ay-dash-em-ee-ar-ar-wye-dash-em-eye-en-gee-oh-dash-pee-eye-pee-dash-pee-ee-ar-ar-wye-dash-pee-eye-en-gee-oh."
examples.ref: 2004, Will Rogers, The Stonking Steps, page 170:

glosses: The name of the Latin script letter Y/y.

examples.text: A wye is used to split a single line [hose or cable] into two lines.
By going around the wye, a train can change direction.

glosses: A Y-shaped object: a wye level, wye-connected. Especially a Y-shaped connection of three sections of road or railroad track.
